Application Data.NAME: Security Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Security Solutions, Inc. provides comprehensive security and investigative services, including unarmed security personnel for commercial and residential properties, event security, and risk assessments. Our highly trained team utilizes state-of-the-art technology for surveillance and access control while adhering to all regulatory requirements and maintaining strict standards for safety and professionalism. We ensure that all personnel are properly licensed and undergo thorough background checks to minimize liability and uphold our commitment to quality service.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/10/2023, a slip and fall incident occurred at a client's event, resulting in a minor injury to a guest. The incident was caused by a wet floor that had not been marked with warning signs. The estimated total loss is $7,000, which includes medical expenses and legal fees. The claim is currently open and under review.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm Monitoring; 24/7 on-site security personnel; regular patrols and surveillance; comprehensive risk assessments; emergency response protocols; access control systems with keycard entry; perimeter fencing; motion-detecting lights; trained watchpersons during events.
